info.name: Clean365 — Serviceman App
info.description:
# Clean365 Serviceman (Field Technician) API

Serviceman sees **assigned bookings** (direct `serviceman_id` or team membership).
- **No** BookingTask, `/provider/booking-task/*`, or attendance write APIs — supervisor marks attendance.
- On team jobs (`team_id` set): `can_update_booking_status=false`; status updates return `booking_status_supervisor_only_403`.
- Detail may include `field_status`, `progress_percent`, `attendances` (read-only).
- Use GPS via `PUT /serviceman/update-location` for admin Live Map only.

request.description:
GPS ping for **admin Live Map** (`/admin/live-map`).
- Saves `users.latitude` / `longitude` and always refreshes `last_seen_at`.
- Call every **5–10s** while on an active field job; every **2–3 min** as heartbeat.
- Rate limit: ~30 writes/min (`429` if exceeded).
- **Not** attendance check-in (supervisor marks attendance).
Body: `{ "latitude": number, "longitude": number }` (both optional for heartbeat-only).

Presence-only ping — refreshes `last_seen_at` without changing coords.
Empty body `{}` is valid.

No task / attendance write APIs — supervisor owns field ops.
